meta.name: Max & the Midknights
meta.description: Join Max, a determined 10-year-old girl with big dreams of becoming a knight, as she leads her friends on an epic adventure filled with excitement, bravery, and lots of fun. Together, they'll battle sword-wielding zombies, duel a malevolent sorceress, and even tame a fire-breathing dragon! Clever, kind, and seriously sassy, Max is always ready to lend a hand — or a sword — whenever anyone needs help.

videos.title: Welcome to Byjovia
videos.overview: Unsatisfied with the troubadour lifestyle, Max dreams of becoming a knight. After escaping from a thief, Max and Uncle Budrick go to Byjovia, Budrick's hometown, but when they arrive, it is not as Uncle Budrick remembers it.

videos.title: Meet the Midknights
videos.overview: When Uncle Budrick is held captive as King Gastley's jester, it's up to Max to rescue him from the castle's dungeon, with a little help from her newest pals, Simon, Millie, Kevyn, and world-renowned wizard, Mumblin.

videos.title: A Midknight Run
videos.overview: Things take an unexpected turn when Max and the Midknights attempt to break into the castle to save Uncle Budrick. Meanwhile, Uncle Budrick entertains King Gastley like his life depends on it.

videos.title: Don't Lose Your Head
videos.overview: Chaos ensues as Max & the Midknights try to break Uncle Budrick out of the castle before he is beheaded. With Mumblin's help, they narrowly escape King Gastley's clutches and later learn from Kevyn that King Conrad is alive!

videos.title: Escape from Byjovia
videos.overview: As King Gastley searches the kingdom for Max and the others, Max & the Midknights learn about a prophecy and devise a plan to escape from Byjovia to find the missing King Conrad.

videos.title: For Whom the Troll Tolls
videos.overview: Knowing there's a prophecy written about her, Max feels confident that the Midknights' quest will be a success; her confidence is dashed when Uncle Budrick is captured by a hungry chef and the Midknights face off with a pair of ferocious trolls.

videos.title: The Road Not Taken
videos.overview: After their run-in with the trolls, Max decides to play it safe and lead the Midknights down a seemingly serene garden trail; unfortunately, Max's choice causes the quest to take a turn when the gang encounters an unexpected obstacle.

videos.title: The Trail of the Dead
videos.overview: Max and the Midknights unwittingly make camp in a graveyard and are surprised when zombies emerge from the ground and attack; they retreat to a cave, where they find a once-noble knight of Byjovia whose courage was magically stolen.

videos.title: A Vial of Valor
videos.overview: Max and the Midknights go to Fendra's cottage to retrieve Sir Gadabout's stolen courage; Millie makes a discovery, but their search for Sir Gababout's courage is interrupted when Fendra returns home.

videos.title: An Uphill Battle
videos.overview: After battling Fendra, Max is determined to get far away from the evil sorceress, even if it means leading the tired Midknights through a snowy mountain; unfortunately, this new journey has dire consequences for Max and her friends.

videos.title: So Slayeth the Prophecy
videos.overview: Max comes face-to-face with an imprisoned dragon and must decide between slaying the dragon to fulfil the prophecy, or doing the right thing and freeing him.

videos.title: Here Be Dragons
videos.overview: As Max is trapped in a haunting fever dream, the rest of the Midknights find themselves in the magical home of dragons, where they must race against the clock to find a way to save Max from the venom that is quickly taking hold.

videos.title: Thoroughly Malevolent Millie
videos.overview: Max is re-energized to find King Conrad and save Byjovia, but the Midknights' quest is interrupted by a strange boy trapped in a tower. Meanwhile, Millie deals with the repercussions of using dark magic.

videos.title: Fens & Enemies
videos.overview: As Max and the Midknights struggle to complete their quest, Mumblin reappears with shocking news, revealing the truth about King Conrad's disappearance, and they soon learn that the threat to Byjovia is even closer than they thought.

videos.title: Dark Knight of the Soul
videos.overview: As Max reels from failing her quest and losing Mumblin, she loses all hope, and it's down to Uncle Budrick to inspire her not to give up. Meanwhile, Millie grows closer to Fendra, and learns how she came to be an all-powerful sorceress.

videos.title: Homeward Bound
videos.overview: With renewed hope, Max, Simon, and Uncle Budrick are ready to take back Byjovia, until they realize that Kevyn is missing; Fendra traverses her old haunts looking for ingredients for her evil spell.

videos.title: And Joust Like That...
videos.overview: Max, Simon, Kevyn, and Uncle Budrick infiltrate Byjovia in disguise, but their plan goes awry when they're swept into Fendra's tournament to find a true knight's courage; a tiny Alice and Nolan attempt to cross the throne room.

videos.title: Before the Storm
videos.overview: Newly reunited, Max and the Midknights break into the castle to find King Conrad and encounter an unexpected obstacle; Fendra finds her courage, as the tournament comes to a shocking close.

videos.title: Battle for Byjovia
videos.overview: In a battle of good vs. evil, Max and the Midknights team up with some unexpected allies to take Fendra down once and for all; their plans are thwarted when Fendra reveals a few tricks up her sleeve that put all of Byjovia in danger.

videos.title: A True Knight's Courage
videos.overview: In a heart-pounding finale, Fendra completes her spell and reigns supreme over Byjovia. The Midknights struggle to regroup after Max takes a devastating blow.

videos.title: A Restless Knight, Part One
videos.overview: After defeating Fendra and Gastley, Max and the Midknights are living their best lives in Byjovia. Although things seem perfect, Max is itching to go on another quest. Her desire for a new adventure is answered when Queen Nerelia of Tresk shows up begging for help.

videos.title: A Restless Knight, Part Two
videos.overview: When the Gnomes of Tresk are kidnapped by a mysterious evil, Max and the Midknights volunteer to save them; Max's plans for her second quest go awry when she learns not all the Midknights are as eager as she is to go on the mission.

videos.title: The Spirit of the Sea
videos.overview: As Max and the Midknights sail across the sea on their quest, they get spooked when Uncle Budrick claims there's a ghost on board their ship; Mumblin fears someone is out to get him.

videos.title: The Trial of Mumblin the Magician
videos.overview: After being blown off course, the Midknights navigate a set of treacherous waterfalls as they try to reach the Gnomes of Tresk; Mumblin pleads for his freedom in Wizard Court where the odds are stacked against him.

videos.title: Honksgiving!
videos.overview: Max and the Midknights wash up on the shore of strange lands where a local holiday puts their party in danger; Sir Gadabout ventures out to clatterback territory and makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Gnomeward Bound
videos.overview: Max and the Midknights have a breakthrough in their quest when they meet a runaway Gnome, but finding the other kidnapped Gnomes is trickier than they think; Mumblin starts his community service in a mysterious building with even stranger employees.

videos.title: Stuck in a Hole
videos.overview: Max and the Midknights find the missing Gnomes of Tresk; the Gnomes are terrified of their captors and Max realizes she needs to inspire them to fight back if they're ever going to escape.

videos.title: Shale Break
videos.overview: In a high stakes jailbreak, Max and the Midknights pull out all the stops to get the Gnomes of Tresk to safety; dead set on escaping Outpost 71, Mumblin tries to reach the elevator Lenny mentioned.

videos.title: A False Victory
videos.overview: Max and the Midknights victoriously return to Byjovia with the missing Gnomes of Tresk, but Max feels that their mission isn't over yet; Millie and Kevyn's sibling rivalry hits a low point when Millie reveals a major secret about Kevyn's new book.

videos.title: Tomb of the Bodkin
videos.overview: Max and the Midknights journey to an ancient tomb to investigate the legend of King Torin and his Bodkin, where they make several unexpected discoveries; Mumblin learns more about operations at the Tower of Time.

videos.title: Odds Bodkins, Part One
videos.overview: Motivated by discoveries made in the tomb, Max and the Midknights race to Byjovia where they are met with a strangely calm King Conrad, but not everything is as it seems. In the dungeon, Gastley hits his head, sending him on an epic romantic quest.

videos.title: Odds Bodkins, Part Two
videos.overview: The Midknights try to uncover the Bodkin's ultimate plan - before they're turned into Bodkins themselves. At Outpost 71, Mumblin and Pete try to find a runaway iguana.

videos.title: Into the Shadows
videos.overview: Max enters the sinister Shadow World to find and rescue her family and friends, but soon discovers that a hideous creature stands in the way of their escape. Meanwhile, Bean and Barley visit Byjovia, where a new king is taking control.

videos.title: Out of the Shadows
videos.overview: Max does her best to lead her friends and family out of the Shadow World. Mumblin risks his life to power outdated technology in the Tower of Time as he seeks answers about the increasing amount of time shrapnel.

videos.title: Shattered
videos.overview: With all the Byjovians gone, Max and the Midknights face defeat. Torin tries to imprison the kids, but with some unexpected help from Bruce the dragon, the Midknights are saved. Max learns there may be a way to save everyone and stop Torin's Bodkin.

videos.title: Time Management
videos.overview: Max and the Midknights arrive at the Tower of Time, where they reunite with Mumblin. Determined to save everyone they've lost, the Midknights decide to travel back in time to prevent Torin's Bodkin from winning, despite Mumblin's warnings...

videos.title: Time After Time
videos.overview: With Mumblin's help, Max and the Midknights travel to the past to stop Queen Nerelia's amulet from falling into Torin's Bodkin's hands. But when Max successfully alters the past, she creates a future that's more than she bargained for.

videos.title: The Great Crossover, Part One
videos.overview: When the Bodkin takes the form of Nate Wright and jumps into the future, Max and the Midknights jump through time to stop him! Now in Big Nate's world, the Midknights must stop the Bodkin before he causes more damage and takes over Nate's school.

videos.title: The Great Crossover, Part Two
videos.overview: As two times collide, Max and the Midknights team up with Nate and his friends to capture the Bodkin before it's too late! But they soon face a new challenge, as the Bodkin starts duplicating more and more...

videos.title: The Great Crossover, Part Three
videos.overview: When the Bodkin turns into a giant monster, the Midknights must stop it before it destroys all of time! If Max can stop the monster and Mumblin can figure out a way to open a time portal, they just might be able to save the world from disappearing!
